ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( AND(PRIORVALUE(Status__c) = "Cancelled", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"))), AND(PRIORVALUE(Status__c) = "Rejected", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rejected"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change status from a terminal state (Cancelled or Rejected)
